title: Microsoft Teams: intelligent recap without saving a transcript
summary: The briefing passes: its availability, licensing, storage, expiry and controls are supported, and it reports the conflicting guidance about whether the recap PowerShell settings currently take effect. Two minor corrections remain: acknowledge the different Copilot value lists and remove the eDiscovery checklist step that has no controls-table row.

claims.claim: Microsoft positions the feature for organisations restricting transcript or recording retention for compliance.
claims.quote: Intelligent recap without saving transcripts provides AI-generated meeting summaries for organizations that don't allow meeting transcripts or recordings, or that need to limit transcript and recording retention for compliance reasons.

claims.claim: The feature article does not describe summary or Recap behaviour after the organiser's account is deleted before expiry.
claims.quote: Searched: "intelligent recap" "without" "transcripts" organizer account deleted OneDrive summary. Read the entire feature article and OneDrive retention/deletion search excerpts; the feature article gives no account-deletion behaviour.

claims.claim: The feature article does not explain application of OneDrive sharing restrictions, sensitivity labels or DLP to summaries.
claims.quote: Searched: sharing, sensitivity labels and DLP in the entire intelligent-recap-without-saving-transcripts article. Read sensitivity-labels-sharepoint-onedrive-files separately: it documents general Word-file support, not application in the feature article.

claims.claim: Sensitivity labels must be enabled and configured for OneDrive files.
claims.quote: Enable built-in labeling for supported Office files and PDF files in SharePoint and OneDrive so that users can apply your sensitivity labels in Office for the web.

claims.claim: MC1275312 names the M365 Copilot (Premium) licence.
claims.quote: This feature will be available to users with an M365 Copilot (Premium) license across platforms, including desktop (Windows and Mac), web, and mobile.

claims.claim: The feature guidance documents no separate meter for this experience at the time of writing in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: "intelligent recap without saving transcripts" pricing meter charge. Read the full feature guidance and recap licensing search excerpts. The guidance names Copilot licences but no separate meter; unrelated document-processing meters do not establish one.

claims.claim: Cost is medium because intended users require an add-on Copilot licence.
claims.quote: Prerequisites: An add-on Microsoft Copilot license for intended users.

claims.claim: Government cloud dates are not published for this roadmap item.
claims.quote: Searched: "intelligent recap" "without saving" "GCC" availability government. Read roadmap record, MC1275312, feature article and Government Channel search excerpt; none states government rollout dates for this item.

claims.claim: Expiry is configured in Teams admin center at Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Copilot and other AI > Set a default expiration time for Intelligent Recap .docx files for non-transcribed meetings.
claims.quote: Go to Meetings > Meeting policies. Select an existing policy or create a new one. Under Copilot and other AI, next to Set a default expiration time for Intelligent Recap .docx files for non-transcribed meetings, enter the number of days that documents are retained.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> -IntelligentRecapDocxFileExpirationDays 180 is the documented PowerShell call to configure expiry.
claims.quote: The following example sets the default expiration time to 180 days. Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policyname> -IntelligentRecapDocxFileExpirationDays 180

claims.claim: An admin UI control for the AllowIntelligentRecap on/off setting is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "AllowIntelligentRecap" "admin center" turn off intelligent recap setting. Read feature guidance and Teams Premium overview search excerpts: the off control is documented in PowerShell, not an admin UI path.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> -AllowIntelligentRecap $false is the documented PowerShell call to disable intelligent recap.
claims.quote: To turn off intelligent recap, use the Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy cmdlet and set the -AllowIntelligentRecap parameter to $false. Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policyname> -AllowIntelligentRecap $false

claims.claim: Copilot is configured in Teams admin center at Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription > Copilot.
claims.quote: Go to Meetings > Meeting policies. Select an existing policy or create a new one. Go to the Recording & transcription section and find the Copilot setting.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> -Copilot Enabled is the documented PowerShell call for Copilot Only during the meeting.
claims.quote: To allow users to use Copilot Only during the meeting in meetings and events created by organizers with this policy: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot Enabled

claims.claim: EnabledWithTranscript is the default Copilot policy value.
claims.quote: On with saved transcript required | EnabledWithTranscript | This is the default value.

claims.claim: EnabledWithTranscriptDefaultOn is another documented Copilot parameter value.
claims.quote: On with transcript saved by default | EnabledWithTranscriptDefaultOn. The Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy reference instead lists: Possible values are: Enabled; EnabledWithTranscript.
claims.fix: Append to controls[2].note: 'The Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy reference lists only Enabled and EnabledWithTranscript, unlike the Copilot guidance cited here.' Reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/powershell/module/microsoftteams/set-csteamsmeetingpolicy#-copilot.

claims.claim: Disabled is another Copilot parameter value documented on the cited Copilot guidance page.
claims.quote: To set the organizer's default Copilot option to Off and allow them to change it, use the following script: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -Copilot Disabled

claims.quote: This feature has not been fully released yet, so the setting will have no effect. This setting controls how many days the intelligent recap docx file is stored before it expires. The default value is 120.

claims.claim: The MicrosoftTeams module's Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy reference contains the named policy parameters.
